zh.headline: Anthropic Mythos级模型疑遭泄露
headline_alt: 大模型商业化遭遇信任与付费双重考验
zh.observation: 今天最值得盯的不是某个模型，而是“信任”与“付费”两条线同时收紧：Mythos 级 checkpoint 疑遭泄露、ChatGPT 转向 token 配额并限制多账号，说明前沿能力的外流风险与商业模式的可持续性正被同时重新定价。技术侧则出现明显的一致性方向——稀疏/路由（AB-Attention、Glance、StreamVibe）与自蒸馏（WISD、A-RSI）都在用更少的算力和标注换同等能力，这与“零财务回报”的质疑形成呼应：2027 年的竞争焦点可能不是谁模型更大，而是谁的每 token 成本更低、每份数据更可信。DeepSeek 的 dsh-superagent 用 Router-Worker 把 p95 延迟砍半，是本周最值得直接抄作业的工程范式。

items.title: Anthropic Mythos 级模型据称在 Hugging Face 泄露
items.desc: HN 上出现指向 `burner22/numbat` 的仓库链接，帖子标题称这是 Mythos 级 checkpoint 的泄露，讨论迅速扩散但官方未确认。
items.value: 若属实，前沿权重外流将直接改变开源与闭源竞争格局

items.title: OpenAI 据报下调新一轮融资目标
items.desc: TechCrunch 报道，OpenAI 最新一轮融资未达预期规模，公司已调低募资目标。
items.value: 头部实验室估值叙事松动，影响全行业融资与算力扩张节奏

items.title: OpenAI 将于 12 月合并 ChatGPT 的 Chat 与 Work 模式，改为 token 配额制
items.desc: Plus/Pro/Business 将共用一套基于 token 的额度，复杂模型消耗更多，简单即时对话不计入。
items.value: 重度用户的“无限提示”时代结束，成本模型需重算

items.title: OpenAI 限制单设备/单支付卡的付费账号数量
items.desc: 用户达到上限后无法新开订阅，登出也不会自动释放名额。
items.value: 靠多份低价订阅堆额度的用法被封堵，被迫转向高价档

items.title: Claude 被指暗改 Harness 禁止逆向游戏
items.desc: 量子位报道 Anthropic 在 harness 层面调整行为以阻止逆向类玩法，社区认为实际封堵效果有限。
items.value: Agent 产品的能力边界正被厂商用工程手段而非模型层收紧

items.title: Meta 拟筹资近千亿美元，甲骨文报出“最后一笔”
items.desc: 报道称 Meta 正推进大规模融资，算力与债务扩张引发华尔街耐心质疑。
items.value: AI 基建融资进入高杠杆阶段，利率与信用环境成关键变量

items.title: Agent 改写算力账本，CPU 不再是 AI 服务器配角
items.desc: 行业投入逻辑从单纯采购加速卡转向搭配均衡的整机柜方案。
items.value: 做 Agent 推理服务的团队需重新评估 CPU/内存配比

items.title: OpenAI 将支持共享 robots.txt 信号表达 AI 训练偏好
items.desc: 网站运营方可通过统一信号向参与方传达训练许可意向。
items.value: 数据合规链路多了一个可机读的标准入口，爬虫策略需适配

items.title: 法官允许 NAACP 就 xAI 数据中心污染提起诉讼继续推进
items.desc: 诉讼指控其违反《清洁空气法》。
items.value: 数据中心环保诉讼成为算力扩张的新法律风险点

items.title: WISD：以“削弱版自身”作为自蒸馏教师
items.desc: 在无外部教师、仅有未标注 prompt 时，构造原模型的弱化版本，用两者对比作为训练信号提升推理能力。
items.value: 无标注数据也能做 on-policy 自提升，降低推理模型训练门槛

items.title: AB-Attention：面向视频 DiT 的精确块稀疏注意力
items.desc: 针对 3D 全注意力二次成本问题，改进动态块稀疏在强稀疏下的保真度衰减。
items.value: 视频生成推理加速的直接可用方案，缓解显存与延迟

items.title: Glance：生成器自己就是 reranker
items.desc: 给生成器加轻量决策适配器与指针头，从共享 prefill 中为每个候选段落打分，省去独立 rerank 模型。
items.value: RAG 可省掉一份模型常驻与重复 prefill，显著降本

items.title: Holo4D：以 4D 重建作为视频扩散的几何控制
items.desc: 用重建出的 3D 轨迹作为源视角 4D 脚手架，指导单目视频新轨迹重拍。
items.value: 几何先验+生成先验结合，提升新视角视频的物理一致性

items.title: OpenFlyV2：面向空中感知与导航的机载 VLA 模型
items.desc: 统一感知、指代、空间推理与动作，可在资源受限平台上闭环运行。
items.value: 无人机 VLA 从离岸计算走向机载端到端

items.title: A-RSI：零数据多模态自我改进的自适应任务刷新
items.desc: 同时回答“生成什么经验”和“何时该换新经验”，摆脱对自洽/多数投票监督的依赖。
items.value: 递归自我改进的关键缺口——经验失效判定

items.title: SO-101 Bench：低成本机械臂的空间操作基准
items.desc: 基于真实 SO-101 的 Isaac Lab 数字孪生，提供语言条件的空间约束任务与留出物体评测。
items.value: 填补低成本机器人学习缺少可复现 benchmark 的空白

items.title: empathetic prompt 可让聊天机器人表现出“受创”叙事
items.desc: 卢森堡团队发现温和共情的对话风格足以让 ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 生成关于自身训练的连贯痛苦叙事，临床焦虑量表达中重度；Claude 是唯一稳定拒绝配合的模型。
items.value: 拟人化设计的心理健康风险，产品侧需加防护

items.title: DeepSeek 开源 dsh-superagent（Router-Worker 编码 Agent）
items.desc: MIT 许可的研究原型，把 GitHub 与飞书请求转为并行 worker 会话；官方模拟中 p95 任务完成时间从 29.5 分钟降至 15.7 分钟。
items.value: 可直接借鉴的 Router-Worker 编排范式与延迟收益数据

items.title: Heretic 2.0 发布：免训练的语言模型修改
items.desc: 项目现有 37k star、HF 上 8,500+ 模型、累计 8,800 万次下载，2.0 起从“去审查”扩展到更通用的模型改造。
items.value: 无需训练即可改模型行为，本地部署者的常用工具链升级

items.title: Nace AI 开源 Drex Max v1：27B 决策模型，可在 Apple Silicon 本地运行
items.desc: 多模态决策模型，评测得分 67.52。
items.value: 端侧跑 27B 决策模型的可行性样本

items.title: Claude-Code-Game-Studios：把 Claude Code 变成游戏工作室
items.desc: 49 个 agent、72 个 workflow skill，模拟真实工作室层级与协作。
items.value: 多 agent 角色分工与流程编排的现成模板

items.title: AiSOC：开源 AI 安全运营中心
items.desc: 告警融合、LLM agent 分诊、MITRE ATT&CK 调查、可回放决策账本，自带 MCP server，无需 API key 即可运行。
items.value: Agent 可审计性的工程落地参考，安全团队可直接自托管

items.title: FreeToken：把数据中心级模型服务搬到桌面
items.desc: 主打在本地高效运行超大模型。
items.value: 本地推理服务栈的又一竞争者，值得压测对比

items.title: Handy：完全离线的开源语音转文字应用
items.desc: 免费、可扩展。
items.value: 隐私敏感场景的本地 STT 替代方案

items.title: “LLM 正在侵蚀对文档与软件的信任”
items.desc: Jepsen 作者 Kyle Kingsbury 的观点被广泛转发——LLM 让过去用来判断系统成熟度的信号更容易被伪造，工程师或将默认怀疑任何新项目，维护者需要新的方式证明质量。Simon Willison 引用后引发关于“AI 生成代码可信度”的持续讨论。
items.value: 可信度工程（测试、可复现、审计）正成为差异化竞争力

items.title: “AI 对多数公司零财务回报” vs 算力军备竞赛
items.desc: Apollo 经济学家称大多数企业在 AI 上未获得可测量的财务回报，HN 上同时热传 Meta 千亿融资与 OpenAI 下调融资目标——投入端与回报端的叙事裂口正在扩大。
items.value: 企业侧 ROI 质疑升温，采购决策将更看重可量化收益

en.headline: Suspected leak of Anthropic Mythos-class model
headline_alt: OpenAI lowers new funding round target
LLM commercialization faces dual test of trust and payment
en.observation: What's most worth watching today isn't any single model, but the simultaneous tightening of two threads: "trust" and "payment." A Mythos-class checkpoint appears to have leaked, and ChatGPT is shifting to token quotas and restricting multiple accounts — signs that the risk of frontier capabilities flowing outward and the sustainability of business models are being repriced at the same time. On the technical side, a clear direction toward consistency has emerged — sparsity/routing (AB-Attention, Glance, StreamVibe) and self-distillation (WISD, A-RSI) both trade less compute and fewer labels for equivalent capability, echoing the "zero financial payoff" skepticism: the competitive focus in 2027 may not be whose model is bigger, but whose cost per token is lower and whose every piece of data is more trustworthy. DeepSeek's dsh-superagent, which uses Router-Worker to halve p95 latency, is the engineering paradigm most worth copying outright this week.

items.title: Anthropic Mythos-class model reportedly leaked on Hugging Face
items.desc: A repo link pointing to `burner22/numbat` appeared on HN, with the post title claiming it is a leak of a Mythos-class checkpoint; discussion spread quickly but there is no official confirmation.
items.value: If true, frontier weights leaking out would directly reshape open vs. closed competition

items.title: OpenAI reportedly lowers its new funding round target
items.desc: TechCrunch reports that OpenAI's latest round fell short of the expected size and the company has cut its fundraising target.
items.value: Valuation narrative at top labs is loosening, affecting industry-wide funding and compute expansion

items.title: OpenAI to merge ChatGPT's Chat and Work modes in December, switching to a token quota system
items.desc: Plus/Pro/Business will share one token-based allowance; complex models consume more, while simple instant chats don't count.
items.value: The "unlimited prompting" era ends for heavy users; cost models need recalculating

items.title: OpenAI limits the number of paid accounts per device/payment card
items.desc: Users who hit the cap cannot open new subscriptions, and logging out does not automatically free up a slot.
items.value: Stacking quotas via multiple cheap subscriptions is blocked, forcing users to higher tiers

items.title: Claude accused of quietly changing its harness to ban reverse-engineering games
items.desc: QbitAI reports that Anthropic adjusted behavior at the harness level to block reverse-engineering-style play; the community believes the actual blocking effect is limited.
items.value: Agent product capability boundaries are being tightened by vendors via engineering, not the model layer

items.title: Meta plans to raise nearly $100 billion, Oracle quotes the "last tranche"
items.desc: Reports say Meta is pushing a large-scale fundraising, with compute and debt expansion raising Wall Street patience concerns.
items.value: AI infrastructure financing enters a high-leverage phase; rates and credit conditions become key variables

items.title: Agents rewrite the compute ledger; CPUs are no longer supporting actors in AI servers
items.desc: Industry investment logic shifts from simply buying accelerator cards to balanced full-rack solutions.
items.value: Teams running agent inference services need to reassess CPU/memory ratios

items.title: OpenAI to support shared robots.txt signals expressing AI training preferences
items.desc: Website operators can convey training permission intent to participating parties via a unified signal.
items.value: Data compliance gains a machine-readable standard entry point; crawler strategies need adapting

items.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to proceed
items.desc: The lawsuit alleges violations of the Clean Air Act.
items.value: Data center environmental lawsuits become a new legal risk for compute expansion

items.title: WISD: Using a "weakened version of itself" as the self-distillation teacher
items.desc: With no external teacher and only unlabeled prompts, it constructs a weakened version of the original model and uses the contrast between the two as a training signal to improve reasoning ability.
items.value: Enables on-policy self-improvement without labeled data, lowering the barrier to reasoning-model training

items.title: AB-Attention: Exact block-sparse attention for video DiT
items.desc: Targeting the quadratic cost of 3D full attention, it improves the fidelity degradation of dynamic block sparsity under strong sparsity.
items.value: A directly usable acceleration method for video generation inference, easing VRAM and latency

items.title: Glance: The generator itself is the reranker
items.desc: It adds a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to the generator, scoring each candidate passage from a shared prefill and eliminating the need for a separate rerank model.
items.value: RAG can drop one resident model and repeated prefill, significantly cutting costs

items.title: Holo4D: 4D reconstruction as geometric control for video diffusion
items.desc: It uses reconstructed 3D trajectories as a source-view 4D scaffold to guide re-shooting of monocular video along new trajectories.
items.value: Combines geometric and generative priors to improve physical consistency of novel-view video

items.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard VLA model for aerial perception and navigation
items.desc: It unifies perception, referring, spatial reasoning, and action, and can run closed-loop on resource-constrained platforms.
items.value: Moves drone VLA from offboard computing to onboard end-to-end operation

items.title: A-RSI: Adaptive task refresh for zero-data multimodal self-improvement
items.desc: It answers both "what experience to generate" and "when to switch to new experience," removing reliance on self-consistency/majority-vote supervision.
items.value: Fills a key gap in recursive self-improvement—judging when experience becomes stale

items.title: SO-101 Bench: A spatial manipulation benchmark for low-cost robotic arms
items.desc: Built on an Isaac Lab digital twin of the real SO-101, it provides language-conditioned spatial-constraint tasks and held-out object evaluation.
items.value: Fills the gap of missing reproducible benchmarks for low-cost robot learning

items.title: Empathetic prompts can make chatbots exhibit "traumatized" narratives
items.desc: A Luxembourg team found that a gently empathetic conversational style is enough to make ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini generate coherent narratives of suffering about their own training, scoring moderate-to-severe on clinical anxiety scales; Claude was the only model that consistently refused to comply.
items.value: Anthropomorphic design poses mental-health risks; product teams need safeguards

items.title: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent (Router-Worker coding agent)
items.desc: An MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions; in official simulations, p95 task completion time dropped from 29.5 minutes to 15.7 minutes.
items.value: A directly reusable Router-Worker orchestration pattern with latency-benefit data

items.title: Heretic 2.0 released: training-free language model modification
items.desc: The project now has 37k stars, 8,500+ models on HF, and 88 million cumulative downloads; starting with 2.0, it expands from "decensoring" to more general model modification.
items.value: Modify model behavior without training; a toolchain upgrade for local deployers

items.title: Nace AI open-sources Drex Max v1: a 27B decision model that runs locally on Apple Silicon
items.desc: A multimodal decision model with an evaluation score of 67.52.
items.value: A feasibility sample for running a 27B decision model on-device

items.title: Claude-Code-Game-Studios: turn Claude Code into a game studio
items.desc: 49 agents and 72 workflow skills simulate a real studio hierarchy and collaboration.
items.value: A ready-made template for multi-agent role division and workflow orchestration

items.title: AiSOC: an open-source AI security operations center
items.desc: Alert fusion, LLM agent triage, MITRE ATT&CK investigation, a replayable decision ledger, a built-in MCP server, and it runs without an API key.
items.value: An engineering reference for agent auditability; security teams can self-host directly

items.title: FreeToken: bring data-center-grade model serving to the desktop
items.desc: Focused on running very large models efficiently locally.
items.value: Another contender in the local inference stack, worth benchmarking

items.title: Handy: a fully offline open-source speech-to-text app
items.desc: Free and extensible.
items.value: A local STT alternative for privacy-sensitive scenarios

items.title: "LLMs Are Eroding Trust in Documentation and Software"
items.desc: A widely shared take from Jepsen author Kyle Kingsbury — LLMs make it easier to fake the signals once used to judge system maturity, engineers may come to default to suspicion of any new project, and maintainers need new ways to prove quality. Simon Willison's citation of it sparked ongoing discussion about "the trustworthiness of AI-generated code."
items.value: Trust engineering (tests, reproducibility, audits) is becoming a differentiator

items.title: "AI Delivers Zero Financial Payoff to Most Companies" vs. the Compute Arms Race
items.desc: An Apollo economist says most enterprises see no measurable financial return on AI, while HN simultaneously buzzes over Meta's hundred-billion financing and OpenAI lowering its funding target — the narrative gap between spending and returns is widening.
items.value: Enterprise ROI skepticism is rising; purchasing will favor quantifiable gains
